execution.lifecycle_basis: Frozen plan specifies fresh process/engine and common warmup/reset; as-run launcher records separate serial CLI invocations. Stage timestamps are observed execution evidence, at one-second resolution.
execution.limits: chain includes lifecycle/startup/idle; process wall includes initialization; makespans exclude initialization; none is GPU kernel time or paid utilization

apc.unit: paired per-seed four-task mean E2E seconds

queue_aware.unit: paired per-seed four-task mean E2E seconds

protocol.authorization: User directed autonomous completion of remaining work after the explicit 1 lifecycle + at most 16 trace GPU proposal.

between_block_foreground_ci.unit: one four-task mean per method per seed; paired method differences across four seeds

protocol.design: Four predeclared new traffic seeds; four-method Williams balanced order; same physical single GPU for every trace; fresh engine/process and common warmup/reset.
protocol.scope_limit: One fixed workload stratum; new seeds are not new task templates. No workload-wide or distribution-free confidence claim. Endogenous scheduling timestamps never enter future-only policy.
protocol.stop: Lifecycle/identity/infrastructure failure blocks scientific comparison; repair only non-scientific harness issues without identity drift. Complete the fixed valid matrix regardless of preliminary latency; no added search on no-go.

scope_limitations: One fixed workload stratum; new seeds are not new task templates. Four independent paired seed means, not 64 independent serial tasks. No pooled background SLO or averaged P95 gate; every semantic block must pass. No workload-wide or distribution-free confidence claim. Endogenous scheduling timestamps never enter future-only policy. Preference is not residency or causal savings; owner release is not cache eviction. Nested CPU timers must not be summed.

trace_storage.semantics: Lossless JSON serialization; gzip is preferred when both copies exist. Corrupt gzip is invalid, never replaced silently with a plain copy.
